$Comment: The Christmas Hat, the head piece of the Christmas Set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Set.json), sold at Elsie the Weaver's Christmas stall once Santa counts a player Nice. A full item body with no Parent, so it inherits no recipe and nobody crafts it: it wears the game's own cotton hood (Armor_Cloth_Cotton_Head's model, texture, icon and armour numbers). Its own stats ride the native Armor block: the cotton hood's resistances plus 5% less Ice damage, Health and Stamina like any armour, and ReputationGain_Christmas_Nice_List (10 is +10%), which raises every gain of Santa's favor while it is worn. Raise or lower an Amount to tune it; the set adds its own bonus on top.
